newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 6.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 6.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Thursday despite winds from a cold front along the northern Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily report.
Veracruz, Coatzacoalcos, Nautla, Alvarado and Salina Cruz ports were shut to smaller tourist and fishing boats because of mild winds.
Ships were advised of high winds and waves in the Gulf of Tehuantepec.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Generally sunny skies, with light rains along the coasts of Sinaloa and Sonora states. Winds reported from the northwest at up to 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) with waves from three to five feet high.
Cold front moving southwest bringing slightly lower temperatures, clouds and isolated light rains.
Winds reported from the north and northeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to six feet high. The cold front is expected to disperse later in the day.
Hot and partly cloudy with possible showers. Winds from 20 to 30 km.
